evidence.excerpt: We evaluate the adapters on candidate World Values Survey (WVS) items using prompts that omit country names and distinguish four questions: recovery of the imposed labels, transfer of the anchor signal to new text, coherence between the GPS anchors and human WVS responses, and agreement between adapter and human scores.
